item.title: Verbose beta 264
item.description:
Your words calendar, and change kind while recording

Also on iPhone

  • Your words calendar: every day you talked, shaded by the words you dictated.
  • More about your words: filler words taken out, your pace, and when you talk most.
  • Change what a recording is while it records: tap its title.
  • Send tasks can send to Verbose Tasks when it's installed.

Release notes on GitHub
